# Get Your Brooklyn Running Company Order with Same-Day Delivery from Getcho


If you’re looking for quality running gear and expert advice, Brooklyn Running Company has you covered. But what if you could get your hands on your Brooklyn Running Company purchase even faster? That’s where Getcho comes in! With our same-day delivery service, you can have your Brooklyn Running Company order delivered to your home in no time. Say goodbye to the hassle of waiting for your package to arrive and hello to the convenience of Getcho.


## **How to Getcho** **Brooklyn Running Company** **for same-day delivery**


Getcho offers an on-demand delivery service with low prices and great customer service. . In addition to ordering from stores and businesses, you can also use Getcho to pick up your Brooklyn Running Company curbside or in-store pickup orders. Simply place your order on[brooklynrunningcompany.com](https://www.brooklynrunningcompany.com/) and use the Getcho app to send a driver to pick it up for you on the same day.


### Place your Brooklyn Running Company curbside / in-store pickup order


1. Start shopping on[brooklynrunningcompany.com](https://www.brooklynrunningcompany.com/)
2. When viewing an item, click on “Check Availability” to see which stores have it in stock
3. Continue to checkout
4. Input your shipping details (even though you’ll select pickup in store)
5. Scroll to the bottom of the checkout page to find “Pickup - Store Name” options
6. Select your preferred store location
7. Complete your payment
8. You will receive a confirmation email
9. Once your order is ready, you’ll receive another email notification


TIP: Keep your order confirmation number and take a screenshot of the barcode. You’ll need to share these with your Getcho driver.


### **Download Getcho**


Download the Getcho app from the[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/getcho/id1460402210) or the[Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gtcho) and create a free account if you don’t have one yet.


### **Input your pickup details**


1.


**Store address** : Make sure you enter the address for the right Brooklyn Running Company location. Start typing Brooklyn Running Company and you’ll be able to see the locations near you.


2.


**Name on order** : Enter the name you ordered with.


3.


**Phone number** : Enter your own phone number. That way, a driver can call or text you if there are any issues.


4.


**Pickup Notes** : Enter all of the information your driver will need to find your order. Something like:


*“This is a curbside order under John Smith. Order # is 2293102. Call if you have any problems!”*


### **Input your drop-off details**


Enter your phone number and any notes that will help a driver find you to drop off your order (apartment number, special instructions, etc…)


Submit your order now or schedule for later. Getcho will send you a tracking link to track your driver. Feel free to contact your driver and check in anytime!


## **Help your driver find your order**


Once your driver is en route, you just have one more step: send your driver a screenshot of the barcode you received.


That’s it! Your driver will pick up your order and deliver it straight to you. Enjoy the free time you saved by using Getcho.
